newsitem.title: CANADA: Revenue Properties completes Las Vegas acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Revenue Properties completes Las Vegas acquisition.

text.p: Revenue Properties Company Ltd on Tuesday said it completed the purchase of a 130,550 square foot mall in Las Vegas, Nevada for about C$22.8 million (US$16.4 million).

The Toronto-based real estate company first announced it would purchase the mall in May, when it said it had agreed to buy the shopping center for C$21 million (US$15.3 million). The company gave no reason for the higher final price.
Revenue Properties said the purchase of the Green Valley Town & Country Shopping Center was funded through the proceeds of a recently completed initial public offering.
Shares of Revenue Properties rose 0.05 to 3.30 in early morning trade on the Toronto Stock Exchange.
